x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description:
This is an optional script to clean-up deprecated tables, scripts and data related to the portfolio and taxonomy tables used in the SPM Limited Access program. Ensure that all data you will to retain has been migrated to the updated tables.
The tables that will be deleted are the service_portfolio, taxonomy_node and taxonomy_layer_definition tables. All data will be deleted from these tables. The new tables are spm_service_portfolio, spm_taxonomy_node and spm_taxonomy_layer_definition.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: SPM Clean-up on portfolio and taxonomy
